Package com.platform.media_service.services.implementations

Class HashService

java.lang.Object
com.platform.media_service.services.implementations.HashService
All Implemented Interfaces:
IHashService
@Service public class HashService extends Object implements IHashService
Service for generating and verifying MD5 and SHA-256 hashes of files. Provides methods to hash files and compare them with provided values for integrity checks.
